source.title: K-Drama Filming Locations: Gyeonggi, Busan & Beyond (2026)

hooks: Post is signed 'Ted K.', who writes he arrived in Korea in 1990 and has lived there 35 years (source article)
Groups Busan's Descendants of the Sun spots (Songdo Beach, BIFF Square, Taejongdae) and notes they cluster near Nampo Station (source article)
Has a 'Why Filmmakers Are Leaving Seoul' section; companion Seoul guide published Jan 2026 (koreapeek.com/k-drama-filming-locations-seoul/)

list.title: K-drama filming spots in Gyeonggi & Busan, from KoreaPeek's guide
list.desc: Places from KoreaPeek's 'K-Drama Filming Locations: Gyeonggi, Busan & Beyond (2026)' (https://koreapeek.com/kdrama-filming-locations-gyeonggi-busan-beyond-2/). Collected by PinWith, not made by KoreaPeek.

items.title: Suwon Hwaseong Fortress (수원 화성)
items.memo: Article lists it for Mr. Sunshine and other period shoots.

items.title: Korean Folk Village (한국민속촌)
items.memo: Yongin folk village the article names as a frequent drama set.

items.title: Heyri Art Village (헤이리 예술마을)
items.memo: Paju art village the article ties to indie-style drama scenes.

items.title: Songdo Beach (송도해수욕장)
items.memo: Descendants of the Sun: beach walk and sunset scenes, per the article.

items.title: BIFF Square (BIFF 광장)
items.memo: Descendants of the Sun festival/street scenes; near Nampo Station.

items.title: Taejongdae (태종대)
items.memo: Descendants of the Sun cliff scenes from the final episodes.

items.title: Gamcheon Culture Village (감천문화마을)
items.memo: Alley scenes; article cites Descendants of the Sun and Moonlight Drawn by Clouds.

items.title: Jagalchi Market (자갈치시장)
items.memo: Fish market used for street-food and local-life scenes in modern dramas.

items.title: Nurimaru APEC House (누리마루 APEC하우스)
items.memo: Article says Goblin used it as a wealthy character's residence.
